description: This PHP source file defines the AuthenticationSubscriber class within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class ensures user authentication consistency, manages session expiration, redirects on session expiry, and enforces security constraints when processing HTTP kernel events.

classes.name: AuthenticationSubscriber
classes.description: Handles user authentication and session management by subscribing to kernel events such as request, controller, and exception events. It manages session expiration, user validation, and redirects on session timeout or unauthorized access within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping kernel events to the subscriber's handler methods, with specified priorities.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Checks if user is authenticated during the request event; stops propagation if not, to trigger authentication.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Performs user validation and session checks before controller execution; throws exceptions or handles session expiry as needed.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles exceptions such as session expiry or unauthorized access by redirecting or responding accordingly.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the controller instance from the event.

methods.name: getSystemUser
methods.description: Fetches the SystemUser entity based on the current authenticated user's ID.

methods.name: isLoggedInUserActive
methods.description: Checks if the user account is active and not deleted.

methods.name: resolveAuthenticatedUserException
methods.description: Validates the system user and returns specific authentication exceptions if issues are detected.

methods.name: hasUserLastModifiedChanged
methods.description: Determines if the user's last modified timestamp has changed since last session.

methods.name: refreshUserLastModified
methods.description: Updates the session's stored last modified timestamp for the user.

methods.name: getUserLastModifiedValue
methods.description: Returns the formatted last modified date of the user as a string.

methods.name: logoutCurrentSession
methods.description: Invalidates the current session and sets the user as unauthenticated upon detecting session expiration or security violations.
